journey.name: ST-05 An emptied list shows the empty state and hides its own controls
journey.description:
Covers FR-08, and the consequence of FR-10 that is easy to miss: both the search field and the sort action are gated on a non-empty task list (TaskListScreen.kt:92,114), so emptying the list takes them away with it.
Deleting four rows makes four calls to the source, which is why the dice are off.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0
